# Lenco API Documentation

> Documentation for Lenco API

Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

## API Reference
- [Welcome to Lenco's API doc](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/introduction.md)
- [Getting Started](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-started.md): This page will help you get started with Lenco API
- [/accounts](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-accounts.md): Retrieve information about your bank accounts
- [/account/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-account-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific bank account
- [/account/:id/balance](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-account-balance.md): Retrieve account balance of a specific bank account
- [/recipients](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-recipients.md): Retrieve information about all your recipients
- [/recipient/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-recipient-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific recipient
- [/recipients](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/create-recipient.md): Create a new recipient
- [/banks](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-banks.md): Get list of banks and financial institutions
- [/resolve](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/resolve-account.md): Verify/resolve account details
- [/transactions](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-transactions.md): Get transactions that occurred on your bank accounts
- [/transaction/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-transaction-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific transaction
- [/transactions](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/create-transaction.md): Create a new transaction, currently only supporting bank transfer
- [/transaction-by-reference/:reference](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-transaction-by-reference.md): Retrieve information about a specific transaction using the client reference
- [/transfer](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/create-transfer.md): Create a new bank transfer transaction
- [/transfer/by-reference/:reference](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-transfer-by-reference.md): Retrieve information about a specific bank transfer transaction using the reference
- [/transfer/bulk](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/create-bulk-transfer.md): Create a bulk transfer, currently only supporting bank transfer
- [/transfer/bulk/by-reference/:reference](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-bulk-transfer-by-reference.md): Retrieve information about a bulk transfer using the reference
- [/virtual-accounts](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/create-virtual-accounts.md): Create a virtual account number
- [/virtual-accounts](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-static-virtual-accounts.md): Get list of all static virtual accounts
- [/virtual-accounts/:account-reference](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-virtual-account-by-account-reference.md): Get a virtual account details by the account reference - both dynamic and static
- [/virtual-account-by-bvn/:bvn](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-static-virtual-account-by-bvn.md): Get a static virtual account details by the bvn
- [/virtual-accounts/transactions](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-virtual-account-transactions.md): Get only successful transactions that occurred on your virtual accounts
- [/virtual-accounts/transactions/:transaction-id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-virtual-account-transaction-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific successful transaction that occurred on a virtual account
- [/virtual-accounts/rejected-transactions](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-rejected-virtual-account-transactions.md): Get only rejected transactions that occurred on your virtual accounts
- [/virtual-accounts/rejected-transactions/:transaction-id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-rejected-virtual-account-transaction-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific rejected transaction that occurred on a virtual account
- [/virtual-accounts/all-transactions](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-all-virtual-account-transactions.md): Get all successful and rejected transactions that occurred on your virtual accounts
- [Bill Payments](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bill-payments.md)
- [/bills/vendors](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-vendors.md): Get the list of vendors for bill payments. You can filter this list by the bill payment category.
- [/bills/vendors/by-category/:category](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-vendors-by-category.md): Get the list of vendors for bill payments for a specified bill payment category.
- [/bills/vendors/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-vendor-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific vendor for bill payments
- [/bills/products](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-products.md): Get the list of vendors for bill payments. You can filter this list by the bill payment category.
- [/bills/products/by-category/:category](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-products-by-category.md): Get the list of vendors for bill payments for a specified bill payment category.
- [/bills/products/by-vendor/:vendorId](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-products-by-vendor-id.md): Get the list of vendors for bill payments for a specified bill payment category.
- [/bills/products/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-product-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific vendor for bill payments
- [/bills/lookup-account](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bills-lookup-account.md): Verify / lookup customer account details for cable-tv and electricity
- [/bills](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/create-bill-payment.md): Create a bill payment. Kindly note that the account you select as `debitAccountId` should be funded as it would be debited for a successful API call.
- [/bills/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/bill-payment-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific bill payment
- [/bills/by-reference/:reference](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/billsby-referencereference.md): Retrieve information about a specific bill payment using the client reference
- [/bills](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-bill-payments.md): Get bill payments that occurred on your bank accounts
- [/point-of-sale/terminals](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-assigned-pos-terminals.md): Retrieve information about your assigned POS terminals
- [/point-of-sale/terminals/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-assigned-pos-terminal-by-id.md): Get details of an assigned POS terminal
- [/point-of-sale/terminals/assign](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/assign-pos-terminal.md): Assign a POS terminal
- [/point-of-sale/terminals/unassign](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/unassign-pos-terminal.md): Unassign a POS terminal
- [/point-of-sale/transactions](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-pos-transactions.md)
- [/point-of-sale/transactions/:id](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-pos-transaction-by-id.md): Retrieve information about a specific POS transaction
- [/point-of-sale/transactions/by-reference/:reference](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/get-pos-transaction-by-reference.md): Retrieve information about a specific POS transaction using the reference
- [/point-of-sale/transactions/webhook/repush](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/repush-pos-transaction-webhook.md): Repush the webhook notification for a POS transaction
- [Webhooks](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/webhooks.md): Learn how to listen to events whenever certain actions occur on your integration.
- [Pricing](https://lenco-api.readme.io/reference/pricing.md)
